title: Use Seedance character source tokens (e.g., @[char1]=<C1>) with preserve…
content:
Use Seedance character source tokens (e.g., @[char1]=<C1>) with preserve complete appearance and ignore background/text to lock identities while keeping the scene controllable.  
Add an explicit continuity rule like Keep identities and outfits continuous to prevent character/outfit drift across cuts.  
Define a fixed environment layout with specific landmarks and include Preserve geography and axis to maintain consistent spatial continuity and screen direction.  
List every key prop with exact counts and ownership (e.g., Exactly one bag…; C1 owns bag/umbrella; C3 carries knife) and instruct No duplicates/teleporting/vanishing to stop prop resets.  
Specify one-time state changes for props (e.g., umbrella breaks once into exactly two pieces; no intact umbrella afterward; pieces remain motionless) to enforce persistent damage continuity.  
Choreograph action with agency constraints (e.g., attackers constantly advance/strike; no posing/watching/waiting; every miss/hit becomes recovery/pursuit) to keep motion continuous and avoid idle frames.  
Control editing by instructing Open mid-attack, hard-cut on contact/counter/prop transfer, and alternate readable wides with tight contacts to get coherent multi-shot action coverage.  
Write the sequence as numbered beats with shot type + camera angle + specific actions + cut points (e.g., High-corner wide → Cut low at puddle level → OTS medium) to guide pacing and shot variety.  
Anchor continuity by assigning “zones” for props (e.g., bag stays in foreground-left puddle zone untouched until retrieval) so the model keeps objects in consistent positions across cuts.  
Include explicit audio design with No dialogue or music and a synchronized SFX list tied to visible causes to steer Seedance toward foley-driven realism without unwanted soundtrack.

es.content:
Usa tokens de fuente de personaje de Seedance (p. ej., @[char1]=<C1>) con preserve complete appearance e ignore background/text para fijar identidades mientras mantienes la escena controlable.  
Añade una regla explícita de continuidad como Keep identities and outfits continuous para evitar la deriva de personaje/vestuario entre cortes.  
Define una distribución fija del entorno con hitos específicos e incluye Preserve geography and axis para mantener una continuidad espacial y dirección de pantalla consistentes.  
Enumera cada prop clave con recuentos exactos y propiedad (p. ej., Exactly one bag…; C1 owns bag/umbrella; C3 carries knife) e indica No duplicates/teleporting/vanishing para impedir reinicios de props.  
Especifica cambios de estado de una sola vez para los props (p. ej., umbrella breaks once into exactly two pieces; no intact umbrella afterward; pieces remain motionless) para imponer una continuidad persistente del daño.  
Coreografía la acción con restricciones de agencia (p. ej., attackers constantly advance/strike; no posing/watching/waiting; every miss/hit becomes recovery/pursuit) para mantener el movimiento continuo y evitar fotogramas inactivos.  
Controla la edición indicando Open mid-attack, hard-cut on contact/counter/prop transfer, y alterna planos generales legibles con contactos cerrados para obtener una cobertura de acción coherente en múltiples planos.  
Escribe la secuencia como beats numerados con tipo de plano + ángulo de cámara + acciones específicas + puntos de corte (p. ej., High-corner wide → Cut low at puddle level → OTS medium) para guiar el ritmo y la variedad de planos.  
Ancla la continuidad asignando “zones” para los props (p. ej., bag stays in foreground-left puddle zone untouched until retrieval) para que el modelo mantenga los objetos en posiciones consistentes entre cortes.  
Incluye un diseño de audio explícito con No dialogue or music y una lista de SFX sincronizados vinculados a causas visibles para orientar a Seedance hacia un realismo impulsado por foley sin banda sonora no deseada.

fr.content:
Utilisez les tokens de source de personnage Seedance (par ex. @[char1]=<C1>) avec preserve complete appearance et ignore background/text pour verrouiller les identités tout en gardant la scène contrôlable.  
Ajoutez une règle explicite de continuité comme Keep identities and outfits continuous pour éviter toute dérive des personnages/des tenues d’un plan à l’autre.  
Définissez une disposition fixe de l’environnement avec des repères précis et incluez Preserve geography and axis afin de maintenir une continuité spatiale et une direction d’écran cohérentes.  
Listez chaque accessoire clé avec des quantités exactes et la propriété (par ex. Exactly one bag…; C1 owns bag/umbrella; C3 carries knife) et indiquez No duplicates/teleporting/vanishing pour empêcher les réinitialisations d’accessoires.  
Précisez les changements d’état ponctuels pour les accessoires (par ex. umbrella breaks once into exactly two pieces; no intact umbrella afterward; pieces remain motionless) afin d’imposer une continuité persistante des dégâts.  
Chorégraphiez l’action avec des contraintes d’agentivité (par ex. attackers constantly advance/strike; no posing/watching/waiting; every miss/hit becomes recovery/pursuit) pour maintenir un mouvement continu et éviter les images d’inactivité.  
Contrôlez le montage en indiquant Open mid-attack, hard-cut on contact/counter/prop transfer, et alternez des plans larges lisibles avec des contacts serrés pour obtenir une couverture d’action multi-plans cohérente.  
Rédigez la séquence sous forme de beats numérotés avec type de plan + angle de caméra + actions spécifiques + points de coupe (par ex. High-corner wide → Cut low at puddle level → OTS medium) pour guider le rythme et la variété des plans.  
Ancrez la continuité en attribuant des « zones » aux accessoires (par ex. bag stays in foreground-left puddle zone untouched until retrieval) afin que le modèle conserve les objets dans des positions cohérentes d’un plan à l’autre.  
Incluez une conception sonore explicite avec No dialogue or music et une liste SFX synchronisée liée à des causes visibles pour orienter Seedance vers un réalisme porté par le foley, sans bande-son indésirable.

ja.content:
Seedance のキャラクターソーストークン（例: @[char1]=<C1>）を使用し、preserve complete appearance と ignore background/text を指定して、シーンの制御性を保ちながらアイデンティティを固定する。  
Keep identities and outfits continuous のような明示的な継続性ルールを追加して、カット間でのキャラクター／衣装のドリフトを防ぐ。  
特定のランドマークを含む固定された環境レイアウトを定義し、Preserve geography and axis を含めて、空間的な継続性と画面方向の一貫性を維持する。  
すべての主要な小道具を正確な数と所有者つきで列挙し（例: Exactly one bag…; C1 owns bag/umbrella; C3 carries knife）、No duplicates/teleporting/vanishing を指示して、小道具のリセットを防ぐ。  
小道具に対する一度きりの状態変化を指定し（例: umbrella breaks once into exactly two pieces; no intact umbrella afterward; pieces remain motionless）、永続的なダメージの継続性を強制する。  
agency constraints を用いてアクションを振り付ける（例: attackers constantly advance/strike; no posing/watching/waiting; every miss/hit becomes recovery/pursuit）ことで、動きを連続させ、アイドルフレームを避ける。  
Open mid-attack, hard-cut on contact/counter/prop transfer, and alternate readable wides with tight contacts を指示して編集を制御し、一貫性のあるマルチショットのアクション描写を得る。  
シーケンスを番号付きのビートとして、shot type + camera angle + specific actions + cut points を含めて記述し（例: High-corner wide → Cut low at puddle level → OTS medium）、テンポとショットの多様性を導く。  
小道具に “zones” を割り当てることで継続性を固定し（例: bag stays in foreground-left puddle zone untouched until retrieval）、カット間でもオブジェクトが一貫した位置に保たれるようにする。  
No dialogue or music と、可視的な原因に紐づいた同期済みの SFX リストを含む明示的な音響設計を加え、不要なサウンドトラックを入れずに Seedance を foley 主導のリアリズムへ誘導する。

ko.content:
Seedance 캐릭터 소스 토큰(예: @[char1]=<C1>)을 사용하고, preserve complete appearance 및 ignore background/text를 적용해 정체성을 고정하면서도 장면은 제어 가능하게 유지하세요.  
Keep identities and outfits continuous 같은 명시적 continuity rule을 추가해 컷 사이에서 캐릭터/의상 드리프트를 방지하세요.  
특정 랜드마크가 있는 고정된 환경 레이아웃을 정의하고 Preserve geography and axis를 포함해 일관된 공간적 연속성과 화면 방향을 유지하세요.  
모든 핵심 소품을 정확한 개수와 소유권까지 명시해 나열하고(예: Exactly one bag…; C1 owns bag/umbrella; C3 carries knife), No duplicates/teleporting/vanishing을 지시해 소품 리셋을 막으세요.  
소품의 일회성 상태 변화도 지정하세요(예: umbrella breaks once into exactly two pieces; no intact umbrella afterward; pieces remain motionless)하여 지속적인 손상 continuity를 강제하세요.  
행동은 agency constraints와 함께 안무를 구성하세요(예: attackers constantly advance/strike; no posing/watching/waiting; every miss/hit becomes recovery/pursuit) ताकि motion을 연속적으로 유지하고 idle frame을 피하세요.  
편집은 Open mid-attack, hard-cut on contact/counter/prop transfer를 지시하고, 읽기 쉬운 wide 샷과 tight contact 샷을 번갈아 사용해 일관된 멀티샷 액션 커버리지를 얻도록 제어하세요.  
시퀀스는 shot type + camera angle + specific actions + cut points를 포함한 번호 매긴 비트로 작성하세요(예: High-corner wide → Cut low at puddle level → OTS medium) ताकि pacing과 shot variety를 안내하세요.  
소품에 “zone”을 할당해 continuity를 고정하세요(예: bag stays in foreground-left puddle zone untouched until retrieval) ताकि 모델이 컷 사이에서도 물체를 일관된 위치에 유지하도록 하세요.  
No dialogue or music와 같이 명시적인 오디오 디자인을 포함하고, 보이는 원인에 연결된 synchronized SFX list를 넣어 Seedance가 원치 않는 사운드트랙 없이 foley-driven realism 쪽으로 가도록 유도하세요.

zh.content:
使用 Seedance 角色源 token（例如 @[char1]=<C1>），并配合 preserve complete appearance 和 ignore background/text，以锁定身份，同时保持场景可控。  
添加明确的连续性规则，例如 Keep identities and outfits continuous，以防止角色/服装在镜头切换间漂移。  
定义固定的环境布局，加入具体地标，并包含 Preserve geography and axis，以保持空间连续性和屏幕方向一致。  
列出每个关键道具的准确数量和归属（例如，Exactly one bag…；C1 owns bag/umbrella；C3 carries knife），并指示 No duplicates/teleporting/vanishing，以防止道具重置。  
为道具指定一次性的状态变化（例如，umbrella breaks once into exactly two pieces；no intact umbrella afterward；pieces remain motionless），以强化持续的损坏连续性。  
通过 agency constraints 编排动作（例如，attackers constantly advance/strike；no posing/watching/waiting；every miss/hit becomes recovery/pursuit），以保持动作连续并避免空闲帧。  
通过指示 Open mid-attack、hard-cut on contact/counter/prop transfer，并交替使用可读的 wides 和 tight contacts 来控制剪辑，从而获得连贯的多镜头动作覆盖。  
将序列写成编号 beats，包含 shot type + camera angle + specific actions + cut points（例如，High-corner wide → Cut low at puddle level → OTS medium），以引导节奏和镜头多样性。  
通过为道具分配“zones”来锚定连续性（例如，bag stays in foreground-left puddle zone untouched until retrieval），这样模型就会在不同切镜中保持物体位置一致。  
加入明确的音频设计，使用 No dialogue or music，并提供与可见原因对应的同步 SFX list，以引导 Seedance 生成以拟音为主的真实感，而不会出现不需要的配乐。
